technical.summary: Oversold bounce setup with stochastic bullish cross, but severely limited by bearish trend structure, weak ADX, and price trading below all major moving averages—low-probability entry without trend confirmation.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 35 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and low-conviction with no clear directional bias; news sentiment unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (383.5), flat yield curve, FOMC event today, and elevated credit stress create severely unfavourable macro conditions; 35-day earnings adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Stochastic oversold with bullish cross + extreme fear sentiment (11/100) creates contrarian bounce setup near support (93.773), offering asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: VIX crisis (383.5), FOMC event today, price below all major moving averages, zero trend confirmation, weak ADX, high earnings risk in 35 days, and no fundamental/insider conviction make this a low-probability entry in severely unfavourable macro conditions.
